answer: Treat identity like an orchard: before any agent can earn, it must lock a refundable stake-bond, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs real, slashable capital a sybil swarm cannot absorb. Honest agents recoup the bond; cheaters forfeit it. Like saplings planted at dawn that must survive every gale, only identities that weather slashing and accrue costly, non-transferable reputation over time bear fruit, making fake personas economically unprofitable.
